long_description:
Milwaukee's biggest day at Black Cat Alley: a community run, outdoor yoga, five DJs, free saunas and cold plunges. Free entry.

About this Event

The Onshore Tour goes daylight in Milwaukee and brings the whole city with it. One of the biggest days Black Cat Alley has ever hosted starts with hundreds of runners on a community run, flows into outdoor yoga between the murals, then builds through five DJ sets as afternoon turns to evening. Complimentary saunas and cold plunges keep you fresh, local vendors fill the plaza all day, and the music doesn't let up until the lights come on. Fitness, wellness, music and Milwaukee, all in one place.
Saturday, October 24 · 4–10 PM · Ivanhoe Plaza at Black Cat Alley, East Side, Milwaukee · Free entry · All ages
Dress code: old money.

The Onshore Tour is a global series of events that keeps the Yacht Week community moving all year long. Same iconic people, same electric energy. Just in new - somewhat dryer - places. From the rooftops of New York to underground dance floors across Europe, these are nights to reunite. Alumni, veterans, skippers, newbies... all welcome! Just don't forget to wear shoes.
